FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_CAES_CompressorIntercooling
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT      : UTILITY-SCALE ADIABATIC COMPRESSED AIR ENERGY STORAGE (A-CAES) FACILITY (300 MWe / 1200 MWh)
  SUBSYSTEM    : MULTI-STAGE CENTRIFUGAL AIR COMPRESSOR INTER-COOLING & CONDENSATE KNOCKOUT DRUM BALANCE
  TAG          : 02-KIC-4100-FB
  DESIGNATION  : SIL-3 / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 / ISA-84 CYBER-PHYSICAL TURBOMACHINERY CONTROLLER
  SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / ISA-18.2 ALARM MATRIX / ISA-88 HYBRID CONTINUOUS-DISCRETE FSM
  AUTHOR       : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS AND THERMODYNAMIC FORMULATION:
  
  1. MULTI-STAGE POLYTROPIC COMPRESSION & INTER-STAGE HEAT REMOVAL:
     The charging cycle of a grid-scale A-CAES plant utilizes a 4-stage intercooled centrifugal compressor train
     absorbing up to 300 MW of renewable electrical power to compress ambient air from 1.013 bar(a) to 140.0 bar(a)
     for injection into deep underground solution-mined salt caverns.
     Polytropic gas compression follows:
         T_discharge / T_suction = (P_discharge / P_suction) ^ ((n - 1) / n)
     Between Stage 1 (pressure ratio r_p = 3.65, P_out ~ 3.7 bar(a), T_out ~ 185 deg C) and Stage 2, heat must be
     extracted via a high-performance shell-and-tube / plate-fin intercooler into a pressurized thermal energy
     storage (TES) heat transfer fluid (HTF) circuit (water/glycol or synthetic thermal oil) to:
         (a) Reduce power demand of Stage 2 by cooling suction air to 38.0 deg C (approaching isothermal compression).
         (b) Store high-grade thermal exergy for cavern discharge air reheating during peak generation.
         (c) Prevent thermal mechanical degradation of downstream impellers, dynamic carbon ring seals, and bearings.

  2. NON-EQUILIBRIUM PHASE TRANSITION & CONDENSATE KNOCKOUT DRUM DYNAMICS:
     As high-mass moist air (up to 220 kg/s) is cooled under pressure, the partial pressure of water vapor exceeds
     the saturation vapor pressure P_sat(T). Vapor undergoes rapid bulk condensation:
         w(T, P) = 0.62198 * P_sat(T) / (P - P_sat(T))   [kg H2O / kg dry air]
     where P_sat(T) is calculated in real-time via the high-accuracy Magnus-Tetens / Buck formulation:
         P_sat(T) = 6.1121 * EXP((18.678 - T / 234.5) * (T / (257.14 + T)))   [mbar]
     The knockout drum separates liquid droplets via gravity sedimentation, centrifugal swirl vanes, and a stainless
     steel wire-mesh demister pad. Liquid water accumulation rate:
         m_dot_cond = m_dot_air * (w_inlet - w_outlet)   [kg/s]
     CRITICAL PROCESS SAFETY REQUIREMENT (SIL-3):
     Any liquid droplet carryover into the Stage 2 impeller (operating at 14,800 RPM with titanium blade tip speeds
     exceeding 480 m/s) induces severe supersonic droplet impingement erosion, blade fatigue cracking, dynamic shaft
     unbalance vibration, and catastrophic aerodynamic surge.
     Conversely, complete drainage loss causes high-pressure compressed air blowby into the atmospheric condensate
     flash tank, resulting in explosive vessel overpressure.

  3. STATE-SPACE DISCRETE PLANT REPRESENTATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC):
     The coupled thermal-hydraulic subsystem is modeled as a 4th-order discrete state-space plant with sampling
     period Ts = 100 ms (0.10 s):
         x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] + E * d[k]
         y[k]   = C * x[k] + D * u[k]
     where:
       State Vector x = [x1, x2, x3, x4]^T:
         x1: Intercooler air exit temperature deviation (Delta T_air_out = T_air_out - 38.0 deg C) [K]
         x2: Knockout drum liquid level deviation (Delta h_drum = Level_voted - 50.0%) [%]
         x3: Core differential pressure drop deviation (Delta DP_core = DP_measured - DP_nominal) [mbar]
         x4: Cooling fluid return temperature deviation (Delta T_cool_out = T_return - T_return_target) [K]
       Manipulated Input Vector u = [u1, u2]^T:
         u1: Cooling water / HTF flow control valve position (0.0 .. 100.0%) [%]
         u2: Knockout drum continuous condensate drain valve position (0.0 .. 100.0%) [%]
       Disturbance Vector d = [d1, d2, d3]^T:
         d1: Air mass flow rate variation (Delta m_dot_air) [kg/s]
         d2: Stage 1 discharge air temperature variation (Delta T_stage1_out) [K]
         d3: Compressor train rotational shaft speed variation (Delta N_rpm) [rpm]

     Continuous-time physics Jacobian matrices linearized around nominal operating point (Air: 180 kg/s, 3.8 bar,
     Cooling flow: 650 m3/h, Drum level: 50.0%):
         A_c = [ -0.1250    0.0000    0.0000    0.0450 ]
               [  0.0380   -0.0420    0.0000    0.0000 ]
               [  0.0000    0.0000   -0.2100    0.0000 ]
               [  0.0550    0.0000    0.0000   -0.0950 ]
     Discretized over Ts = 0.1s via matrix exponential Phi = exp(A_c * Ts):
         A = [ 0.8825    0.0000    0.0000    0.0423 ]
             [ 0.0036    0.9589    0.0000    0.0000 ]
             [ 0.0000    0.0000    0.7945    0.0000 ]
             [ 0.0518    0.0000    0.0000    0.9094 ]
         B = [ -0.2850    0.0000 ]
             [  0.0082   -0.1945 ]
             [  0.0015    0.0000 ]
             [  0.1462    0.0000 ]
         E = [  0.1240    0.2180    0.0008 ]
             [  0.0415    0.0000    0.0002 ]
             [  0.0182    0.0000    0.0012 ]
             [  0.0645    0.0842    0.0004 ]
         C = Eye(4),   D = Zero(4,2)

     MPC Optimization Criterion:
     Minimizes the finite-horizon quadratic objective function:
         J(k) = Sum_{j=1..Np} [ (y(k+j) - r(k+j))^T * Q * (y(k+j) - r(k+j)) ] +
                Sum_{j=0..Nu-1} [ Delta_u(k+j)^T * R * Delta_u(k+j) ]
     where Q = diag(12.0, 18.0, 2.5, 4.0) and R = diag(1.5, 2.0).
     The unconstrained analytical Riccati gain matrix K_mpc and feedforward disturbance rejection matrix K_ff
     are pre-computed and evaluated cyclically with strict actuator slew rate and saturation limiters.

  4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHM:
     Three independent, physically separated level sensors monitor the knockout drum:
         - LT1: High-frequency Guided Wave Radar (GWR) probe (flange-mounted top chamber)
         - LT2: Differential Pressure (DP) transmitter with capillary remote seals
         - LT3: Magnetostrictive continuous displacer sensor (external bypass bridle)
     The 2oo3 voting engine computes pairwise absolute residuals:
         e12 = |LT1 - LT2|,  e23 = |LT2 - LT3|,  e31 = |LT3 - LT1|
     If any channel deviates beyond the tolerance limit (delta > 5.0%) for longer than debounce time (300 ms),
     or suffers out-of-range hardware fault (NAMUR NE43 breakdown < 3.8 mA or > 20.5 mA), the faulty transmitter
     is isolated and the voting engine degrades gracefully:
         2oo3 Healthy (Median Vote) -> 2oo2 Averaging (Single Fault) -> 1oo1 Last Healthy (Dual Fault) -> Failsafe Trip.

  5. COMPREHENSIVE ISA-18.2 / ISA-84 DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH ALARM HIERARCHY:
     Incorporates multi-tier trip latches, first-out indication, demister pad differential pressure surge margin
     biasing, and emergency high-capacity drain dump control.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Safety Permissives and Master Commands --- *)
    bMasterEnable                   : BOOL;     (* Main CAES compression train master enable [TRUE=Permitted] *)
    bEmergencyStopOk                : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 emergency stop circuit [TRUE=Healthy, FALSE=Tripped] *)
    bAutoModeSelect                 : BOOL;     (* Control mode selection: TRUE = Automatic MPC, FALSE = Safe Coordinated Manual *)
    bManualReset                    : BOOL;     (* Operator manual reset pushbutton for latched critical trips *)

    (* --- Turbomachinery Dynamic Operation Measurements --- *)
    rCompressorSpeed_RPM            : REAL;     (* Multi-stage centrifugal compressor shaft speed [rpm] (0.0 .. 18000.0) *)
    rAirMassFlow_kgs                : REAL;     (* Primary air inlet mass flow rate [kg/s] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    rStage1DischargePress_bar       : REAL;     (* Stage 1 discharge air pressure upstream of intercooler [bar] (1.0 .. 35.0) *)
    rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC       : REAL;     (* Stage 1 discharge air temperature upstream of intercooler [deg C] (20.0 .. 250.0) *)

    (* --- Intercooler Aerodynamic and Thermal Measurements --- *)
    rInterstageAirPress_bar         : REAL;     (* Intercooler outlet air pressure entering knockout drum [bar] (1.0 .. 35.0) *)
    rInterstageAirTemp_DegC         : REAL;     (* Intercooler outlet air temperature entering knockout drum [deg C] (5.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rIntercoolerDiffPress_mbar      : REAL;     (* Core air-side differential pressure drop across heat exchanger [mbar] (0.0 .. 800.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterSupplyTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* Cooling medium / thermal energy storage supply temperature [deg C] (10.0 .. 50.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterReturnTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* Cooling medium return temperature downstream of intercooler [deg C] (15.0 .. 95.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h           : REAL;     (* Cooling water circulation volumetric flow rate [m3/h] (0.0 .. 1500.0) *)

    (* --- Knockout Drum Redundant Instrumentation (2oo3 TMR) --- *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 1: Guided Wave Radar [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 2: Differential Pressure [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 3: Magnetostrictive Displacer [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDemisterDiffPress_mbar         : REAL;     (* Knockout drum wire-mesh demister pad differential pressure [mbar] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch      : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 discrete float switch LSHH for carryover trip [FALSE=Trip] *)

    (* --- Ambient Atmospheric Psychrometric Conditions --- *)
    rAmbientAirTemp_DegC            : REAL;     (* Ambient weather station dry-bulb temperature [deg C] (-25.0 .. 50.0) *)
    rAmbientHumidity_Pct            : REAL;     (* Ambient weather station relative humidity [%] (5.0 .. 100.0) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Primary Process Safety and Status Indicators --- *)
    bSystemReady                    : BOOL;     (* Subsystem operational readiness status indicator *)
    bCompressorTripInterlock        : BOOL;     (* Hardwired emergency trip signal to compressor ESD [TRUE = Trip Train] *)
    bDegradedModeActive             : BOOL;     (* Operating under degraded sensor redundancy (2oo2 or 1oo1) *)

    (* --- Modulated Final Control Elements (Actuation Signals) --- *)
    rCoolingWaterValve_Pct          : REAL;     (* Modulated cooling water flow control valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rCondensateDrainValve_Pct       : REAL;     (* Modulated continuous condensate drain valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct         : REAL;     (* High-capacity rapid blowdown emergency drain valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct       : REAL;     (* Feedforward dynamic opening bias added to Stage 1 anti-surge valve [%] (0.0 .. 50.0) *)

    (* --- Packed Diagnostic and Alarm Words --- *)
    wAlarmWord                      : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm annunciator word (Bit0=Trip, Bit1=LAHH, etc.) *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Subsystem operational state and mode packed word *)

    (* --- Validated Process and Thermodynamic Analytics --- *)
    rVotedDrumLevel_Pct             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR resolved and validated knockout drum liquid level [%] *)
    rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh : REAL;     (* Real-time theoretical water condensation mass rate [kg/h] *)
    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW        : REAL;     (* Real-time thermal exergy transferred to cooling fluid / TES [kW] *)
    rIntercoolerThermalEff_Pct      : REAL;     (* Real-time heat exchanger thermal effectiveness [%] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Registers (ISA-88 Architecture) --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := 0; (* State transition audit index *)
    bStateInitialized               : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3 TMR) Voting Registers --- *)
    bSensor1_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensor2_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensor3_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorCount             : INT := 3;
    rDelta12                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta23                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta31                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct          : REAL := 5.0;  (* Maximum allowed deviation between channels [%] *)
    tonSensor1FaultTimer            : TON;
    tonSensor2FaultTimer            : TON;
    tonSensor3FaultTimer            : TON;
    bSensor1FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bSensor2FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bSensor3FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* --- Discrete State-Space Model Representation (Ts = 0.1s) --- *)
    rState_x1_TempErr               : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta T_air_out [K] *)
    rState_x2_LevelErr              : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta h_drum [%] *)
    rState_x3_PressLoss             : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta DP_core [mbar] *)
    rState_x4_ReturnTempErr         : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta T_cool_out [K] *)

    (* State Transition Matrix A (4x4) *)
    rA11 : REAL := 0.8825; rA12 : REAL := 0.0000; rA13 : REAL := 0.0000; rA14 : REAL := 0.0423;
    rA21 : REAL := 0.0036; rA22 : REAL := 0.9589; rA23 : REAL := 0.0000; rA24 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA31 : REAL := 0.0000; rA32 : REAL := 0.0000; rA33 : REAL := 0.7945; rA34 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA41 : REAL := 0.0518; rA42 : REAL := 0.0000; rA43 : REAL := 0.0000; rA44 : REAL := 0.9094;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B (4x2) *)
    rB11 : REAL := -0.2850; rB12 : REAL :=  0.0000;
    rB21 : REAL :=  0.0082; rB22 : REAL := -0.1945;
    rB31 : REAL :=  0.0015; rB32 : REAL :=  0.0000;
    rB41 : REAL :=  0.1462; rB42 : REAL :=  0.0000;

    (* Disturbance Coupling Matrix E (4x3) *)
    rE11 : REAL := 0.1240;  rE12 : REAL := 0.2180;  rE13 : REAL := 0.0008;
    rE21 : REAL := 0.0415;  rE22 : REAL := 0.0000;  rE23 : REAL := 0.0002;
    rE31 : REAL := 0.0182;  rE32 : REAL := 0.0000;  rE33 : REAL := 0.0012;
    rE41 : REAL := 0.0645;  rE42 : REAL := 0.0842;  rE43 : REAL := 0.0004;

    (* Disturbance State Vector *)
    rDist_d1_FlowErr                : REAL := 0.0;
    rDist_d2_InletTempErr           : REAL := 0.0;
    rDist_d3_SpeedErr               : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Feedback Gain Matrix K_mpc (2x4) *)
    (* Derived from Discrete Algebraic Riccati Equation with Q and R weightings *)
    rK_mpc_11 : REAL := -0.7420; rK_mpc_12 : REAL :=  0.0150; rK_mpc_13 : REAL := -0.0050; rK_mpc_14 : REAL :=  0.1850;
    rK_mpc_21 : REAL :=  0.0450; rK_mpc_22 : REAL := -0.8920; rK_mpc_23 : REAL :=  0.0000; rK_mpc_24 : REAL :=  0.0000;

    (* Model Predictive Control Feedforward Disturbance Rejection Gain Matrix K_ff (2x3) *)
    rK_ff_11 : REAL := 0.3250;  rK_ff_12 : REAL := 0.5120;  rK_ff_13 : REAL := 0.0018;
    rK_ff_21 : REAL := 0.1180;  rK_ff_22 : REAL := 0.0240;  rK_ff_23 : REAL := 0.0005;

    (* Control Target Setpoints *)
    rAirTempTarget_DegC             : REAL := 38.0; (* Optimum interstage air temperature [deg C] *)
    rDrumLevelTarget_Pct            : REAL := 50.0; (* Optimum knockout drum liquid level setpoint [%] *)
    rNominalAirMassFlow_kgs         : REAL := 180.0;(* Plant baseline mass flow rating [kg/s] *)
    rNominalStage1Temp_DegC         : REAL := 185.0;(* Plant baseline stage 1 discharge temp [deg C] *)
    rNominalSpeed_RPM               : REAL := 14800.0; (* Plant rated operating speed [rpm] *)

    (* Actuator Command Accumulators & Slewing Limits *)
    rCoolingValve_Accum             : REAL := 35.0;
    rDrainValve_Accum               : REAL := 25.0;
    rMaxValveSlew_PctPerSec         : REAL := 15.0; (* Maximum valve rate-of-change [%/s] *)
    rSampleTime_s                   : REAL := 0.10; (* Controller execution cycle time [s] *)

    (* Signal Conditioning and First-Order Filter Accumulators *)
    rAirFlow_Filt                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rInterstageTemp_Filt            : REAL := 38.0;
    rDrumLevel_Filt                 : REAL := 50.0;
    rCoolingFlow_Filt               : REAL := 0.0;
    rDemisterDP_Filt                : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilterAlpha                    : REAL := 0.20; (* First-order PT1 smoothing filter coefficient *)

    (* Thermodynamic Condensation Calculation Variables *)
    rSatPress_Inlet_mbar            : REAL := 0.0;
    rSatPress_Outlet_mbar           : REAL := 0.0;
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg            : REAL := 0.0;
    rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg           : REAL := 0.0;
    rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar        : REAL := 0.0;
    rSpecHeatAir_kJkgK              : REAL := 1.006; (* Isobaric specific heat of dry air [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    rSpecHeatWater_kJkgK            : REAL := 4.186; (* Specific heat of liquid water [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    rLatentHeatVap_kJkg             : REAL := 2260.0;(* Latent heat of vaporization at condensation temp [kJ/kg] *)

    (* System Watchdogs, Timers and Pulse Generators *)
    tonStartupPermissiveDelay       : TON;
    tonPrechargeTimer               : TON;
    tonShutdownCooldownTimer        : TON;
    tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer    : TON;
    tonHighTempPersistenceTimer     : TON;
    tonDemisterDPPersistence        : TON;
    tonResetDebounce                : TON;
    tonEmergencyDumpTimer           : TON;

    (* Diagnostic Counters and Statistical Trackers *)
    udiExecutionCycles              : UDINT := 0;
    udiEmergencyTripCount           : UDINT := 0;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds     : UDINT := 0;
    rCumulativeDrainVolume_m3       : REAL := 0.0;
    bFirstScan                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    bTripLatch                      : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiExecutionCycles := udiExecutionCycles + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 0: FIRST SCAN INITIALIZATION AND SIGNAL CONDITIONING (PT1 EXPONENTIAL FILTERING)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    rAirFlow_Filt        := rAirMassFlow_kgs;
    rInterstageTemp_Filt := rInterstageAirTemp_DegC;
    rDrumLevel_Filt      := (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct) / 3.0;
    rCoolingFlow_Filt    := rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h;
    rDemisterDP_Filt     := rDemisterDiffPress_mbar;
    bFirstScan           := FALSE;
ELSE
    rAirFlow_Filt        := rAirFlow_Filt        + rFilterAlpha * (rAirMassFlow_kgs - rAirFlow_Filt);
    rInterstageTemp_Filt := rInterstageTemp_Filt + rFilterAlpha * (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt);
    rCoolingFlow_Filt    := rCoolingFlow_Filt    + rFilterAlpha * (rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h - rCoolingFlow_Filt);
    rDemisterDP_Filt     := rDemisterDP_Filt     + rFilterAlpha * (rDemisterDiffPress_mbar - rDemisterDP_Filt);
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) LEVEL SENSOR VOTING AND HEALTH VALIDATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 1.1: Physical boundary range check conforming to NAMUR NE43 standard *)
IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor1_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor1_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor2_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor2_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor3_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Step 1.2: Compute pairwise absolute residuals between transmitters *)
rDelta12 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct);
rDelta23 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct);
rDelta31 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct);

(* Step 1.3: Fault isolation and persistence debouncing (300 ms delay) *)
tonSensor1FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor1_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor1FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor1FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

tonSensor2FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor2_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor2FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor2FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

tonSensor3FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor3_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor3FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor3FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Step 1.4: Count active healthy channels and resolve voted process value *)
iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bSensor3FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    (* 2oo3 Normal Operation: True Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) OR
       ((rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct;
    ELSIF ((rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) OR
          ((rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Averaging Mode *)
    IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched AND NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched AND NOT bSensor3FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds := udiDegradedOperationSeconds + 1;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Single-Channel Mode *)
    IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct;
    ELSIF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds := udiDegradedOperationSeconds + 1;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Redundancy Breakdown: Failsafe Default to 85% to Force Emergency Drainage *)
    rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := 85.0;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Smooth the resolved voted level through low-pass filter *)
rDrumLevel_Filt := rDrumLevel_Filt + rFilterAlpha * (rVotedDrumLevel_Pct - rDrumLevel_Filt);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: CRITICAL PROCESS SAFETY INTERLOCKS AND FIRST-OUT ESD TRIP LATCHING (SIL-3)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Condition A: External Emergency Stop Loop Interruption *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopOk THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE; (* Master ESD trip active *)
END_IF;

(* Condition B: Knockout Drum High-High Liquid Level Carryover Threat (LAHH) *)
(* Dual-path protection: Hardwired float switch OR Voted level > 82.0% for 500 ms *)
tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer(IN := (rDrumLevel_Filt > 82.0) OR NOT bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch, PT := T#500MS);
IF tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE; (* LAHH Critical Moisture Carryover Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Condition C: Interstage Air High-High Thermal Overload (TAHH > 80.0 deg C for 2.0 s) *)
tonHighTempPersistenceTimer(IN := (rInterstageTemp_Filt > 80.0), PT := T#2000MS);
IF tonHighTempPersistenceTimer.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.5 := TRUE; (* TAHH Extreme Air Exit Temperature Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Condition D: Demister Pad Severe Differential Pressure Blockage (PDAHH > 180.0 mbar for 1.5 s) *)
tonDemisterDPPersistence(IN := (rDemisterDP_Filt > 180.0), PT := T#1500MS);
IF tonDemisterDPPersistence.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* PDAHH Demister Blown / Heavy Carryover Surge Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Trip Reset Handling *)
tonResetDebounce(IN := bManualReset, PT := T#1000MS);
IF tonResetDebounce.Q AND bEmergencyStopOk AND bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch AND
   (rDrumLevel_Filt < 65.0) AND (rInterstageTemp_Filt < 60.0) AND (rDemisterDP_Filt < 100.0) THEN
    bTripLatch := FALSE;
    bSensor1FaultLatched := FALSE;
    bSensor2FaultLatched := FALSE;
    bSensor3FaultLatched := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.1 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Assign Trip Interlock Output *)
IF bTripLatch THEN
    bCompressorTripInterlock := TRUE;
    udiEmergencyTripCount    := udiEmergencyTripCount + 1;
ELSE
    bCompressorTripInterlock := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC CONDENSATION RATE AND HEAT RECOVERY EXERGY CALCULATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculation of ambient water vapor partial pressure via Magnus equation *)
rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar := (rAmbientHumidity_Pct / 100.0) * 6.1121 *
                            EXP((17.67 * rAmbientAirTemp_DegC) / (rAmbientAirTemp_DegC + 243.5));

(* Inlet air moisture ratio entering Stage 1 (assumed conserved up to intercooler) *)
IF (1013.25 - rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar) > 10.0 THEN
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg := 0.62198 * rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar / (1013.25 - rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar);
ELSE
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg := 0.0150;
END_IF;

(* Intercooler exit saturation vapor pressure at cooled interstage pressure & temperature *)
IF (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC > 0.0) AND (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC < 120.0) THEN
    rSatPress_Outlet_mbar := 6.1121 * EXP((17.67 * rInterstageTemp_Filt) / (rInterstageTemp_Filt + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatPress_Outlet_mbar := 68.0; (* Failsafe value at ~38 deg C *)
END_IF;

(* Exit moisture ratio under compressed conditions [bar -> mbar: * 1000] *)
IF ((rInterstageAirPress_bar * 1000.0) - rSatPress_Outlet_mbar) > 500.0 THEN
    rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg := 0.62198 * rSatPress_Outlet_mbar / ((rInterstageAirPress_bar * 1000.0) - rSatPress_Outlet_mbar);
ELSE
    rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg := 0.0050;
END_IF;

(* Condensation Mass Rate: m_dot_cond = m_dot_air * (w_in - w_out) [kg/s -> kg/h] *)
IF (rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg > rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg) AND (rAirFlow_Filt > 5.0) THEN
    rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh := rAirFlow_Filt * (rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg - rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg) * 3600.0;
ELSE
    rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Thermal Heat Duty Recovered into Cooling Circuit / TES [kW]:
   Q = m_dot_air * Cp_air * (T_in - T_out) + m_dot_cond * h_fg *)
IF (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC > rInterstageTemp_Filt) AND (rAirFlow_Filt > 5.0) THEN
    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW := (rAirFlow_Filt * rSpecHeatAir_kJkgK * (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt)) +
                               ((rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh / 3600.0) * rLatentHeatVap_kJkg);
ELSE
    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Intercooler Heat Exchanger Thermal Effectiveness:
   epsilon = (T_hot_in - T_hot_out) / (T_hot_in - T_cold_in) *)
IF (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rCoolingWaterSupplyTemp_DegC) > 10.0 THEN
    rIntercoolerThermalEff_Pct := ((rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt) /
                                   (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rCoolingWaterSupplyTemp_DegC)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rIntercoolerThermalEff_Pct := 85.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE ESTIMATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 4.1: Compute State Deviations from Target Equilibrium Operating Point *)
rState_x1_TempErr       := rInterstageTemp_Filt - rAirTempTarget_DegC;
rState_x2_LevelErr      := rDrumLevel_Filt - rDrumLevelTarget_Pct;
rState_x3_PressLoss     := rIntercoolerDiffPress_mbar - 120.0; (* Nominal DP = 120 mbar *)
rState_x4_ReturnTempErr := rCoolingWaterReturnTemp_DegC - 75.0; (* Target return temp = 75 deg C *)

(* Step 4.2: Compute Exogenous Disturbance Deviations *)
rDist_d1_FlowErr      := rAirFlow_Filt - rNominalAirMassFlow_kgs;
rDist_d2_InletTempErr := rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rNominalStage1Temp_DegC;
rDist_d3_SpeedErr     := rCompressorSpeed_RPM - rNominalSpeed_RPM;

(* Step 4.3: Model Predictive Control Law: Delta_u = K_mpc * x + K_ff * d
   u1 = Cooling Water Control Valve Command [%]
   u2 = Condensate Drum Continuous Drain Valve Command [%] *)
IF bAutoModeSelect AND NOT bTripLatch AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    (* Valve 1 (Cooling Flow) Control Increment *)
    rCoolingValve_Accum := rCoolingValve_Accum +
                           (rK_mpc_11 * rState_x1_TempErr +
                            rK_mpc_12 * rState_x2_LevelErr +
                            rK_mpc_13 * rState_x3_PressLoss +
                            rK_mpc_14 * rState_x4_ReturnTempErr) * rSampleTime_s +
                           (rK_ff_11 * rDist_d1_FlowErr +
                            rK_ff_12 * rDist_d2_InletTempErr +
                            rK_ff_13 * rDist_d3_SpeedErr) * rSampleTime_s;

    (* Valve 2 (Condensate Continuous Drain) Control Increment *)
    rDrainValve_Accum := rDrainValve_Accum +
                         (rK_mpc_21 * rState_x1_TempErr +
                          rK_mpc_22 * rState_x2_LevelErr +
                          rK_mpc_23 * rState_x3_PressLoss +
                          rK_mpc_24 * rState_x4_ReturnTempErr) * rSampleTime_s +
                         (rK_ff_21 * rDist_d1_FlowErr +
                          rK_ff_22 * rDist_d2_InletTempErr +
                          rK_ff_23 * rDist_d3_SpeedErr) * rSampleTime_s;

    (* Feedforward Condensate Mass Production Level Trimming *)
    IF rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh > 50.0 THEN
        rDrainValve_Accum := rDrainValve_Accum + (rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh / 2500.0) * 0.15;
    END_IF;

    (* Anti-Surge Recycle Dynamic Bias *)
    IF rDemisterDP_Filt > 90.0 THEN
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct := ((rDemisterDP_Filt - 90.0) / 90.0) * 25.0;
    ELSE
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Actuator Physical Saturation Limits *)
    IF rCoolingValve_Accum > 100.0 THEN rCoolingValve_Accum := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rCoolingValve_Accum < 5.0   THEN rCoolingValve_Accum := 5.0;   END_IF; (* Maintain minimal circulation *)

    IF rDrainValve_Accum > 100.0 THEN rDrainValve_Accum := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rDrainValve_Accum < 0.0   THEN rDrainValve_Accum := 0.0;   END_IF;

    rCoolingWaterValve_Pct    := rCoolingValve_Accum;
    rCondensateDrainValve_Pct := rDrainValve_Accum;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-88 MULTI-STAGE CONTINUOUS-DISCRETE OPERATIONAL FINITE STATE MACHINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: STANDBY / SYSTEM OFFLINE
          All active cooling and drainage held at safe parked positions.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rCoolingWaterValve_Pct      := 5.0;   (* Minimal thermal circulation to prevent freezing *)
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct   := 0.0;   (* Tight shutoff to preserve nitrogen blanket *)
        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct   := 0.0;
        rCoolingValve_Accum         := 5.0;
        rDrainValve_Accum           := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0000;

        tonStartupPermissiveDelay(IN := bMasterEnable AND bEmergencyStopOk AND NOT bTripLatch, PT := T#2000MS);
        IF tonStartupPermissiveDelay.Q THEN
            iPreviousState := 0;
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Pre-Purge & Coolant Circulation *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: PRE-PURGE & COOLANT CIRCULATION PRECHARGE
           Establish baseline cooling water flow and verify zero level baseline.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rCoolingWaterValve_Pct      := 35.0;  (* Precharge cooling fluid to avoid initial thermal shock *)
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct   := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0010;

        tonPrechargeTimer(IN := (rCoolingFlow_Filt > 150.0), PT := T#5000MS);
        IF tonPrechargeTimer.Q THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF rCompressorSpeed_RPM > 2000.0 THEN
                iPreviousState := 10;
                iState := 20; (* Compressor Ramp-Up Acceleration *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 10;
            iState := 80; (* Abort to Cooldown / Shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: COMPRESSOR STARTUP ACCELERATION
           Centrifugal train speeding up, aerodynamic pressure building up.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        rCoolingWaterValve_Pct      := 45.0;
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct   := 15.0;  (* Initial drainage cracked open for warming condensate *)
        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct   := 5.0;   (* Modest surge margin padding *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0020;

        (* Check transition to normal closed-loop MPC *)
        IF (rCompressorSpeed_RPM >= 14000.0) AND (rStage1DischargePress_bar >= 3.0) THEN
            rCoolingValve_Accum := 45.0;
            rDrainValve_Accum   := 20.0;
            iPreviousState      := 20;
            iState              := 30; (* Normal Online MPC Regulation *)
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 20;
            iState := 99; (* Critical Emergency Trip Latched *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 30: NORMAL ONLINE MPC REGULATION
           Full multi-variable closed-loop optimization running active matrix control.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady      := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0030;

        (* High Condensate Liquid Level Surge Detected (LAH > 68.0%) *)
        IF rDrumLevel_Filt > 68.0 THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 70; (* Transition to High Condensate Purge Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Sensor Degradation Transition *)
        IF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 50; (* Degraded Sensor Operation *)
        END_IF;

        (* Shutdown sequence initiation *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 40: PEAK CHARGE TRANSIENT MODULATION
           Handling rapid grid frequency response / high CAES power throttling (>220 kg/s).
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady      := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0040;

        (* Enforce proactive cooling valve boost for high thermal load *)
        IF rAirFlow_Filt > 210.0 THEN
            IF rCoolingWaterValve_Pct < 75.0 THEN
                rCoolingWaterValve_Pct := 75.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 30; (* Return to Normal Regulation *)
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 50: SENSOR DEGRADED OPERATION (2oo2 / 1oo1)
           Operates with wider safety margins and tighter rate limits.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady      := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0050;

        (* More aggressive drainage bias to guarantee no liquid carryover *)
        IF rDrainValve_Accum < 35.0 THEN
            rDrainValve_Accum := 35.0;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iPreviousState := 50;
            iState := 30; (* Return to normal if sensors restored *)
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 50;
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 70: ABNORMAL HIGH CONDENSATE PURGE MODE
           Voted level exceeded 68%. Force continuous valve to 100% and pulse emergency dump.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady              := TRUE;
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct := 100.0;
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct := 15.0; (* Open anti-surge to relieve aerodynamic thrust *)
        wSystemStatusWord         := 16#0070;

        (* Engage emergency dump valve if level remains above 74% *)
        IF rDrumLevel_Filt > 74.0 THEN
            rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct := 100.0;
            tonEmergencyDumpTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4000MS);
        ELSE
            rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct := 0.0;
            tonEmergencyDumpTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        (* Recover to normal when level safely drops below 52% *)
        IF (rDrumLevel_Filt < 52.0) THEN
            rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct := 0.0;
            rDrainValve_Accum := 40.0;
            iPreviousState := 70;
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 70;
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    80: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 80: CONTROLLED COOLDOWN & RAMP-DOWN SEQUENCE
           Compressor train unloading, cool down heat exchanger slowly to prevent thermal shock.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rCoolingWaterValve_Pct      := 20.0;
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct   := 40.0;  (* Evacuate remaining drum water *)
        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct   := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0080;

        tonShutdownCooldownTimer(IN := (rCompressorSpeed_RPM < 500.0), PT := T#10000MS);
        IF tonShutdownCooldownTimer.Q THEN
            tonShutdownCooldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iPreviousState := 80;
            iState := 0; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

        IF bTripLatch THEN
            iPreviousState := 80;
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 99: CRITICAL EMERGENCY TRIP LATCHED (FIRST-OUT SHUTDOWN)
           Interlock command active, drain dump deployed, cooling held at failsafe position.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rCoolingWaterValve_Pct      := 100.0; (* Full cooling to quench residual stage thermal soak *)
        rCondensateDrainValve_Pct   := 100.0; (* Maximum drainage *)
        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 100.0; (* Fully open rapid blowout *)
        rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct   := 50.0;  (* Maximum recycle to dump train pressure *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0099;

        (* Require physical trip unlatch and manual reset *)
        IF NOT bTripLatch AND bMasterEnable THEN
            rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct := 0.0;
            iPreviousState := 99;
            iState := 0; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: CONDENSATE BLOWBY PREVENTION (LOW-LOW LEVEL LOCKOUT LALL)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Protect against gas seal blowby: If drum level drops below 12.0%, slam drain valves shut immediately *)
IF (rDrumLevel_Filt < 12.0) AND (iState <> 99) THEN
    rCondensateDrainValve_Pct := 0.0;
    rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct   := 0.0;
    rDrainValve_Accum         := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.4              := TRUE; (* LALL Gas Blowby Lockout Active *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.4              := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 7: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY ALARM HIERARCHY PACKING & DIAGNOSTIC WORD ENCODING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Bit 0: Master ESD Trip Latched *)
wAlarmWord.0 := bTripLatch;

(* Bit 1: High-High Liquid Level LAHH Carryover Hazard *)
(* Set in Layer 2 *)

(* Bit 2: High Liquid Level LAH (Level > 68.0%) *)
wAlarmWord.2 := (rDrumLevel_Filt > 68.0);

(* Bit 3: Low Liquid Level LAL (Level < 25.0%) *)
wAlarmWord.3 := (rDrumLevel_Filt < 25.0);

(* Bit 4: Low-Low Liquid Level LALL Gas Blowby Protection *)
(* Set in Layer 6 *)

(* Bit 5: High-High Interstage Temperature TAHH (> 80.0 deg C) *)
(* Set in Layer 2 *)

(* Bit 6: High Interstage Temperature TAH (> 48.0 deg C) *)
wAlarmWord.6 := (rInterstageTemp_Filt > 48.0);

(* Bit 7: High Demister Differential Pressure PDAH (> 120.0 mbar) *)
wAlarmWord.7 := (rDemisterDP_Filt > 120.0);

(* Bit 8: Level Sensor 1 Disqualified / Faulted *)
wAlarmWord.8 := bSensor1FaultLatched;

(* Bit 9: Level Sensor 2 Disqualified / Faulted *)
wAlarmWord.9 := bSensor2FaultLatched;

(* Bit 10: Level Sensor 3 Disqualified / Faulted *)
wAlarmWord.10 := bSensor3FaultLatched;

(* Bit 11: Total Redundancy Lost (Operating on 1oo1 or Failsafe) *)
wAlarmWord.11 := (iHealthySensorCount <= 1);

(* Bit 12: Heat Exchanger Core Fouling Warning (DP_core > 350 mbar) *)
wAlarmWord.12 := (rIntercoolerDiffPress_mbar > 350.0);

(* Bit 13: Cooling Water Flow Deficit (< 100 m3/h while compressor running) *)
wAlarmWord.13 := (rCompressorSpeed_RPM > 5000.0) AND (rCoolingFlow_Filt < 100.0);

(* Bit 14: Dynamic Surge Margin Warning (Anti-surge bias engaged) *)
wAlarmWord.14 := (rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct > 5.0);

(* Bit 15: Cyclic Execution Watchdog Heartbeat *)
wAlarmWord.15 := (udiExecutionCycles MOD 2 = 0);

(* Accumulate cumulative condensate volume estimate (0.1s time step) *)
rCumulativeDrainVolume_m3 := rCumulativeDrainVolume_m3 +
                             ((rCondensateDrainValve_Pct / 100.0) * 8.5 * (rSampleTime_s / 3600.0));

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
